title: Deposit, Balance-Due and Cancellation Schedule for Good Faith & Price Estimates
content:
This schedule states, for each Good Faith & Price Estimates type, the deposit percentage, the balance-due days, the full-refund cancellation days, the late-cancellation fee and the refund terms that apply to deposits held on an estimate.

## Schedule by estimate type

| Estimate type | Deposit percentage | Balance-due days before the scheduled service date (0 means no pre-service balance) | Full-refund cancellation days before the scheduled service date | Late-cancellation fee (USD, never more than the deposit held) | Fee waived when the cancelling physician documents a medical reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Single Scheduled Service | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | yes |
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Procedure with Co-Providers | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | yes |
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Recurring Course of Care | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | yes |
| Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | yes |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Imaging & Diagnostics | 100 | 0 | 1 | 25.00 | yes |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery | 50 | 7 | 7 | 150.00 | yes |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery | 25 | 30 | 30 | 250.00 | yes |

## Payment and refund terms (identical on all seven types)

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Methods accepted for deposits | card through the patient portal; card by phone; ACH bank draft |
| Deposit refund issued within | 30 calendar days after the cancellation |
| Refund method | the original payment method |
| When held deposits are applied to the hospital account | at the final bill |

## Points of reading

- The four non-package types collect no deposit and carry no late-cancellation fee.
- The balance-due days and the full-refund days are calendar days counted back from the scheduled service date.
- Example (hypothetical): on a type with 7 full-refund days and a service on the 20th of a month, the 13th is 7 days before the service date.
